details:
When setting up ClientSim, you need to (among other things) update the Input Manager configuration. This is usually done by clicking a button which then copies the asset "Packages/com.vrchat.worlds/Integrations/ClientSim/Editor/Resources/.ClientSimInputManagerRaw.asset" into the ProjectSettings folder.

However, the ".ClientSimInputManagerRaw.asset" file is not present in the Unity Package.

Due to this, Linux users need to copy the NON-RAW settings to where the raw settings normally would be.

Solutions:

- Fix the VPM CLI for Linux (it can't detect the editor automatically, and fails when configuring it manually)

- Make the Creator Companion cross-platform. It's not that hard and, assuming you don't use hard-coded paths, means only switching the build target (so like 5 minutes, including testing the damn thing)

- During the build process of the Unity Package, add all necessary hidden files / folders to the Unity Package after the  [Export Package...] function finished.
title: [CRITICAL] File not found: .ClientSimInputManagerRaw.asset
